description: Use this when the user asks which ETFs hold a stock, which fund holds the most of it, how many funds hold it, or whether it is in VOO, SPY, IVV, QQQ, VTI or SCHD. Returns the covered US ETFs that hold it, sorted by the stock's weight in each fund, largest first, each with its weight, rank, dollars, holdings date and source, plus the count, how many funds hold it as their largest position, the funds and issuers with the most dollars in it, and one sentence to quote. The list keeps the heaviest holders, so a broad fund where the stock weighs little can fall outside it; whether the six funds above hold it is in every answer for a stock with its own stock file, whatever top is, unless compact is true. Funds holding it through swaps, futures or options are listed apart, as notional exposure. Not for one stock's weight in another fund (compare_stocks) or the share ETFs own (get_etf_ownership).

compact.description: true for an answer about half the length. It keeps the counts, rank_summary (how many funds hold the stock as their largest or a top 10 position), name_collision (funds whose name contains the company's name) and the sentence to quote. It leaves out top_by_value (the funds holding the most dollars of it), membership (whether VOO, SPY, IVV, QQQ, VTI and SCHD hold it, and its weight in the three largest sector or industry funds that hold it), by_issuer (the issuers holding the most dollars), fee_per_1000 (the yearly cost, in the cheapest funds, of each $1,000 of the stock held through them) and each fund's rank, positions and value.

ticker.description: The stock's ticker, not the company name, for example NVDA for Nvidia. A line listed outside the US carries its market after a dot, for example 7203.JP (Toyota in Tokyo), SAN.FR (Sanofi in Paris) or 005930.KR (Samsung Electronics); an earlier key without the market, such as 7203, is read as the key it became. A key ending in .PFD is not a market: it is the issuer's preferred shares, a US line apart from the common stock (JPM.PFD, held by preferred stock funds).

top.description: How many funds to return, sorted by the stock's weight in each fund, largest first, from 1 to 200; 50 when left out.

name: find_etfs_holding_stock

sec_nport.description: null when the SEC filings were not searched.

weight_pct.description: The stock's weight in the fund.

title: ETFs that hold a stock
